round: V26 late-game cutoff from first-6144 positions
status: frozen before pool generation and before any continuation outcome
motivation: V25 (whole games) showed no effect of cutoff 0.005 on 3072->6144 but 43 vs 27 games reaching 12288 (exact McNemar p=0.068, Holm 0.14). This round tests the late phase directly.
rules: official-modern (RULES.md); THREES_BONUS_RULE unset; 12288 ends the game

pool.policy: website default AI: V23, depth 5, cutoff 0.01, leaf clamp 0, no node/time cap
pool.extension: if fewer than 1024 kept states, add further blocks of 400 consecutive seeds until at least 1024
pool.keep: state right after the first 6144 appears, unless the game is already over (terminal states excluded)
pool.selection: sort kept states by opening seed; evaluation uses exactly the first 1024; no other filtering
pool.freeze: pool file SHA-256 recorded in pool-manifest.json before any continuation starts

continuation.rolloutSeed: 26200001 + pool index; unsent ordinary deck reshuffled with it; same seed for all arms
continuation.search: every move must complete the full depth (no node or time cap)
continuation.websiteMapping: a board holding 6144 keeps it until the game ends, so each arm equals switching to that setting once the real board max reaches 6144

power: from V25 conditional rates (about 6.3% vs 10.0% after 6144), about 0.8 for one comparison at Holm alpha 0.025

analysis.primaryTest: two-sided exact McNemar per comparison, Holm familywise alpha 0.05 over P1,P2
secondary: scoreGained paired mean difference with normal-approximation 95% CI and paired t p-value, A1-B and A2-B
A2 vs A1 reach-12288 exact McNemar (exploratory)
CPU ms per move (8 concurrent processes; not a web latency)
analysis.stopping: fixed sample, no interim outcome analysis

browserCheck.states: first 128 6144-phase states of training/v25-adaptive-cutoff/browser/states.txt (archived V21 pool; not evaluation positions)
browserCheck.parity: untimed JS vs native C++ directions on the same states for all arms
browserCheck.scope: desktop Chromium on this M2 Pro; mobile not measured

adoption: Adopt a candidate only if (1) its primary comparison is Holm-significant in favour of the candidate, (2) its scoreGained difference vs B is not significantly negative, (3) in the browser check it completes its full depth on >=99% of 6144-phase measurements with P95 < 160 ms, and (4) JS/native parity has no mismatch. If both candidates qualify, adopt A1 (cheaper) unless the exploratory A2-vs-A1 McNemar favours A2 with p<0.05. Otherwise keep the website default unchanged.
pilot: timing only, 8 positions of training/v21-late-train/pools/train-6144.txt, rollout base 99260001: ms/move D5/.01 3.7, D5/.005 6.6, D6/.01 6.8, D6/.005 16.1 (max 67 ms). Outcomes of the pilot were not examined.
